newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 1996 passenger car sales up 22.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 1996 passenger car sales up 22.5 percent.

text.p: Malaysia's passenger car sales in 1996 rose by 22.5 percent to 275,615 units from a year earlier, the Malaysian Motor Traders Association (MMTA) said in its annual report on Thursday.
The trade group forecast that passenger car sales would rise by eight percent to 297,664 in 1997. In 1995, passenger car sales jumped 42.6 percent.

"Coupled with an outstanding year for the Malaysian economy, with a GDP (Gross Domestic Product) growth rate of 8.5 percent it is envisaged that sales will register a continued growth in 1997," Aishah Ahmad, chairman of the trade body said in the report.
The MMTA report said commercial vehicle sales rose by 47.0 percent to 69,444 units in 1996 over 1995, and were expected to grow by 23.0 percent to 85,680 units in 1997.
